package web

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// Private rehearsal: exercise only the real static handler, never consumer main,
// stores, authentication, external integrations or domain routes.
func TestAppKitRehearsalStaticCSS20260913(t *testing.T) {
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	(&Server{}).Handler().ServeHTTP(recorder, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/static/tw.css", nil))
	if recorder.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("CSS status = %d, want 200", recorder.Code)
	}
	if contentType := recorder.Header().Get("Content-Type"); !strings.HasPrefix(contentType, "text/css") {
		t.Errorf("CSS content type = %q", contentType)
	}
	body := recorder.Body.Bytes()
	const expectedSHA = "1df389c0861e679eedb9c1c6d5c47fd86a356e3389ba372a0ec45f6bad345921"
	if got := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(body)); got != expectedSHA {
		t.Errorf("served CSS SHA-256 = %s, want independently rebuilt artifact %s", got, expectedSHA)
	}
	// Hex escapes keep this test from supplying utility candidates to the CSS
	// scanner. The independently inspected Shell owns the following selectors.
	for _, selector := range []struct{ name, value string }{
		{"desktop sidebar", "\x2e\x6d\x64\x5c\x3a\x66\x6c\x65\x78"},
		{"keyboard skip link", "\x2e\x66\x6f\x63\x75\x73\x5c\x3a\x6e\x6f\x74\x2d\x73\x72\x2d\x6f\x6e\x6c\x79"},
	} {
		if !bytes.Contains(body, []byte(selector.value)) {
			t.Errorf("missing %s selector %q", selector.name, selector.value)
		}
	}
}
